title: Mountain eBike Tour
requirements: Not recommended for travelers with spinal injuries
Not recommended for travelers with poor cardiovascular health
Suitable for all physical fitness levels
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
Feel the rush of adrenaline as you navigate switchbacks and rocky terrain powered by the assistance of your electric mountain bike. Ride along a section of the 1300-mile-long trail that the members of the Church of Jesus Christ of Latter-Day Saints traveled in 1846-47. Whether you're a seasoned rider or a beginner seeking thrills, this tour promises an unforgettable experience in the great outdoors.

There is a minimum of 3 riders for the tour to run.

*Gratuity Not Included
